content: xcresulttool(1): 'xcrun xcresulttool get test-results summary --path X.xcresult', 'get test-results tests', 'get test-results test-details --test-id <id>', 'get test-results activities' extract structured results incl. per-test detail and activity trees from .xcresult bundles produced with -resultBundlePath; useful for enumerating suite-level skips/disables and crash diagnostics. CI already uploads TestResults.xcresult on failure (_test.yml).
